title: Hold On To Your Butts by Recent Cutbacks at Soho Playhouse #holdontoy...
transcript: Downtown at Soho Playhouse is a three-person Jurassic Park parody. Clocking in at just over an hour, this production is fast and furious but manages to recreate all of the film's most iconic frames with a comically scrappy sensibility. While I probably enjoyed the prop work and the live foley effects more than much of the actual text, I am admittedly very rusty on the source material. As with most parody, you'll get more out of it if you're picking up on more of the references. Regardless, the strengths of this production are plenty, like the physical comedy and the dialect work. What I like the most is how the show leverages its lo-fi production value to maximize both comedy and theatricality. Instead of opting for projections or big set pieces to establish location, they play with scale and ambient sounds, using cardboard frames to force your perspective. In the era of AI, crazy tech effects, and big broadway budgets, I do think there's something to be said for just kind of throwing it together, with a creative impulse. If you're looking for a comedy or just something nostalgic, Hold On To Your Butts is running through March 15th. With that, another program for my collection.
